source: Alshammari, Kitaev and Pyatkin, arXiv:2507.16469v1, Section 4, Conjecture 1; to appear in J. Automata, Languages and Combinatorics (accepted 26 February 2026)
scope: Credit, if all gates pass, for refuting Conjecture 1 (R(C_m □ C_n) >= 4 for m, n >= 3, m+n >= 8) by an explicit 45-letter 3-uniform word representing C_3 □ C_5. No separate credit for neighbouring cases, the Lean bridge or the search.
retention_ruling: QUALIFIED LIMITATION under the 346167/330264/332037 precedent: the author's publication list (entry 176) gives the paper as to appear in JALC and links its PDF to arXiv:2507.16469; Strathprints records acceptance, keeps the toroidal-conjecture abstract sentence and links the arXiv access document; the accepted manuscript is embargoed to 2099 and unread.
methodological_qualification: a generic positional SMT encoding and representation-number tool already exist (Akgun-Gent-Kitaev-Zantema, JIS 22 (2019), census through nine vertices; a source author is a coauthor). This is not the 355701 profile: the 2025 source prescribes no toroidal search procedure and explicitly conjectures the opposite; the witness is a 15-vertex graph beyond the published census; the discovery used its own total-order CNF and Lean does not trust the solver. State this plainly in the paper; no new-method claim.
significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: a complete refutation of an explicit human-posed conjecture by a small certificate at its first new case, comparable to 346167 and 332037
